capabilities: View .drawio and .dio files with a page selector for each diagram page
Display all pages of .drawio.svg files that contain an embedded mxfile
Embed the first or a named page of a diagram in Markdown notes
Open a multi-page SVG preview from the command palette
disambiguation: Not a Drawio editor; it only renders existing diagram files and cannot create or modify diagrams.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README covers supported file types and Markdown embed syntax but not troubleshooting or limits.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view Drawio diagram files or navigate the individual pages within them.

relations.evidence: An offline, read-only multi-page Drawio viewer.

summary: Read-only viewer that opens multi-page Drawio diagram files (.drawio, .dio, .drawio.svg) offline inside Obsidian.
